title: Dependency and Package Rescue

approval.review_mode: Arena Agent Mode implementation plus self-audit; no independent reviewer is claimed.

qualified_environment.artifact_origin: local source build; no PyPI or release qualification is claimed

verification.result: Six profiles resolved with exact hashes: core 36, voice 90, vision 88, desktop 26, dev 92, all 219.
Exact dev lock installed; no broken requirements found.

scope_boundaries_and_nonclaims: B01 qualifies only CPython 3.11 on Linux x86_64; Windows and macOS are not qualified.
The voice, vision, desktop, and all profiles are resolver-qualified only; native library availability, model downloads, hardware devices, and complete runtime workflows were not exercised.
No PyPI upload, signed release, tag, release channel, or external artifact distribution is claimed.
Frontend lint/build/audit success is not frontend interaction, accessibility, or workflow qualification.
The backend health probe confirms startup and contract shape under core dependencies, not whole-product readiness.
B02 owns idempotent install/start/stop/restart and platform qualification; no B02 implementation is claimed.
B03 owns the remaining broad-suite failures and CI enforcement.
The project is not 10/10 at B01 closure; later locked batches and the dogfood/final-audit gates remain mandatory.
risk_acceptance: License metadata for docutils 0.23 and qrcode 8.2 requires later human/legal review if distribution scope expands.
Resolved optional profiles can be very large, especially the all profile and its accelerator stack.
Local artifact qualification does not establish reproducibility on another operating system or CPU architecture.
Current source retains capability-level optional dependencies and known broad-suite failures by design; hiding them through an oversized core install was rejected.
